note: Community-association campground at the end of Diamond Drive in Exshaw, beside the rec grounds and near the railway line. Compact gravel sites with picnic tables; one communal fire pit and a central cook shelter. Drinking water from the rec grounds. Walking trails lead to the Bow River. RV length is given as up to 24 ft in the intro and up to 35 ft in the site details. --Claude
summary: Read the association's page and rate sheet: 16 sites (1-8 unserviced C$25, 9-11 15 A and 12-16 30 A at C$40), first-come except private-event dates, vault toilets, no dump, water from the rec grounds. Fees, booking, hookups (water/sewer false added) and facilities now manual. Not waterfront kept. Google 3.8 (27).
